scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fixedlist
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fixedlist --only firestore "npm --prefix functions test"
